sources.notes: National affected-person register ingestion runs hourly; source labels and status changes are preserved without silent deduplication.
Separate missing-person dataset. Parser is implemented; completeness across pagination and source availability remains under verification. Absence is never interpreted as found.
Separate located-person dataset. Parser is implemented; reconciliation against missing and other registers remains independent.

Current indexed disaster register exposes hundreds of records and includes downstream recoveries in Nuwakot, Chitwan, Nawalparasi and other locations. Individual records preserve recovery date/place, estimated age/sex where reported, storage/location narrative and source URL. No automated identity/death matching.
Cross-check exposes Rasuwa-disaster-labelled bodies in the wider unidentified-body register and is retained independently to detect endpoint inconsistencies or omissions.

sources.notes: Confirms impacts across Rasuwa, Nuwakot, Dhading, Chitwan, Gorkha and Tanahun and 15 municipalities declared disaster crisis-affected areas.
